title: Yellowstone & Wyoming
placeholder: Placeholder · best late May to September
subtitle: A round trip from Jackson Hole. Fossil Butte out and back on Day 1, Grand Teton, the Rockefeller Parkway and Old Faithful on Day 2, then Grand Prismatic early on Day 3 before heading back over Teton Pass.

days.title: Fly to Jackson Hole
days.html:
✈︎

OAK or SFO → JAC after work

Jackson Hole Airport sits inside Grand Teton, so the park starts at the runway. Nonstops vary by season; a connection through SLC or DEN is normal.

Pick up a round-trip rental at JAC (Costco Travel). No one-way drop fee.

Sleep in Jackson for two nights, about 15 minutes south. Tomorrow leaves at 7:45 AM.

Navigate to Jackson ↗
Once dates are set: book West Yellowstone for Night 2 and Jackson for Nights 0–1 (summer rooms sell out months ahead). Flagg Ranch and Fossil Butte’s daily hours run roughly Memorial Day to Labor Day, so that’s the window.

days.title: Fossil Butte and back
days.cut: The long drive is today, so the park days stay in the parks. The afternoon is free in Jackson.

days.title: The Tetons, then Old Faithful
days.sub: Jackson → Moose → Jenny Lake → Flagg Ranch → Old Faithful → West Yellowstone
days.cut: Yellowstone’s interior roads close in winter, so Google Maps only routes the Flagg Ranch → Old Faithful → West Yellowstone legs in season; times are summer estimates. Download offline maps in Jackson.

days.title: Grand Prismatic, then home
days.sub: West Yellowstone → Grand Prismatic → Driggs → Teton Pass → JAC
days.cut: Out through Idaho, so no road repeats. Teton Pass (WY-22) is steep but paved; it’s the direct way back to Jackson from Idaho. A flight at 2 PM or later works.

stops.via: US-189/191 south through Hoback Junction, then US-189 through Daniel and La Barge, about 155 mi.
stops.name: Fossil Butte NM
stops.addr: Fossil Butte National Monument Visitor Center, 864 Chicken Creek Rd, Kemmerer, WY
stops.hrs: Summer, about Memorial Day – Labor Day: daily 8 AM – 5:30 PM. Off-season hours are shorter.
stops.ok: The fossils are inside: fish, bats, palm fronds and a 13-foot crocodile in the stone. Fully accessible; plan about an hour.
stops.about: A 50-million-year-old lake bed, one of the richest fossil deposits in the world.

stops.via: Leave about 11:30. The same road back north; lunch in Kemmerer or along the way.
stops.name: Jackson, WY
stops.note: Same hotel. Free afternoon: the Town Square antler arches and the Elk Refuge pullouts north of town. Tomorrow leaves at 7:30 AM.

stops.via: US-191 north past the airport to Moose Junction.
stops.name: Grand Teton NP
stops.place: Craig Thomas Discovery & Visitor Center, Moose
stops.addr: Craig Thomas Discovery and Visitor Center, Moose, WY
stops.hrs: Seasonal, roughly spring through October, about 8 AM – 5 PM. Confirm for your dates.
stops.ok: Stamp first, then the big windows and relief map. New park for the 64.
stops.about: The Teton Range rises 7,000 feet straight off the valley floor with no foothills in the way.

stops.via: Leave about 8:40. North on Teton Park Road.
stops.name: Jenny Lake
stops.addr: Jenny Lake Visitor Center, Grand Teton National Park
stops.note: The peaks straight across the water. The paved path along the shore is flat for the first stretch. Oxbow Bend is a pullout on the way north.

stops.unit: John D. Rockefeller Jr. Memorial Parkway
stops.via: Leave about 10:05. Past Jackson Lake on US-89/191.
stops.name: Rockefeller Parkway
stops.addr: Flagg Ranch Information Station, Moran, WY
stops.hrs: Seasonal, about early June to early September.
stops.warn: If Flagg Ranch isn’t open yet, the same stamp is usually at Colter Bay Visitor Center, which you pass on the way.
stops.ok: Its own NPS unit between the two parks. A quick in-and-out.
stops.about: Twenty-four thousand acres linking Grand Teton and Yellowstone, named for the man who bought up the valley land and gave it to the parks.

stops.via: Leave about 11:15. In the South Entrance, past Lewis Lake and West Thumb, over Craig Pass. Summer estimate.
stops.name: Yellowstone NP
stops.addr: Old Faithful Visitor Education Center, Yellowstone National Park
stops.hrs: Late April to early November, about 8 AM – 8 PM in summer.
stops.warn: Afternoon is the busiest time here in July–August; give parking extra time.
stops.ok: Lunch, stamp, then check the posted eruption time; Old Faithful goes about every 90 minutes. The Upper Geyser Basin boardwalk starts out front.
stops.about: The first national park, set aside in 1872. Half the world’s geysers are here, on top of a supervolcano.

stops.via: Leave about 2:45. North along the Firehole and out the West Entrance.
stops.name: West Yellowstone, MT
stops.note: Hotel TBD for one night. Tomorrow leaves at 7:00 AM to beat the Grand Prismatic crowds.

stops.via: In the West Entrance to Madison Junction, then south. Watch for bison on the road.
stops.name: Grand Prismatic Spring
stops.addr: Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone National Park
stops.note: The boardwalk loop at Midway, or the overlook trail from the Fairy Falls lot (about a mile, some uphill) for the rainbow view from above.
stops.ok: Early morning is the window for parking.

stops.title: Jackson Hole → home
stops.note: Leave about 8:30. Back out the West Entrance (~40m), then US-20 into Idaho, ID-33 through Driggs and over Teton Pass (~2h 50m). Lunch in Driggs or Jackson. Return the car at JAC and fly home.
